### What the Resurrection Means to Us
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/battle-of-the-gods-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-march-9-2016.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 15:22
Points:
- Christ's resurrection assures believers of their own future bodily resurrection.
- His victory serves as proof that God's justice will ultimately prevail over injustice.
- The resurrected Savior provides spiritual power to overcome sin and live transformed lives today.

### Don't Get Burned!
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-july-20-2012.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 15:33
Points:
- Moral compromise in relationships always produces spiritual damage.
- Believers falsely assume their goodness will rub off on sinful companions.
- Just as clean gloves in mud get soiled, bad company will inevitably corrupt character.

### Death in Adam, Life in Christ
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/death-in-adam-life-in-christ
Passage: 1 Corinthians 15:20-22
Points:
- Christ rising as the firstfruits guarantees the future bodily resurrection of His people.
- Physical and spiritual death entered creation through Adam's representation of humanity.
- Jesus came as the new Adam to secure righteousness and resurrection life for believers.
- Believers are called to trust Christ's finished work and rest in the promise of eternal life.

### Time with God - October 10
Author: Time with God
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/timewithgod/time-with-god-october-10-2021.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 15:20-26
Points:
- Christ's resurrection assures believers of life beyond physical death.
- Jesus was the first of many who will be bodily raised upon His return.
- Believers who pass away dwell in heaven with the Lord awaiting their resurrected bodies.
- Christ will continue His reign until every enemy, culminating in death, is destroyed.
